last_assistant_message:
No code bugs there, purely doc/config. I have enough to finalize findings.

## Findings

```json
[
  {
    "file": "workflows/dream-cycle/steps/step-03-semantic-promotion.md",
    "line": 105,
    "summary": "Step instructs setting state.yaml current-step to step-04 directly, skipping the newly-inserted step-03b-guardrail-checkpoint that the workflow map and NEXT STEP link now point to.",
    "failure_scenario": "Dream cycle runs step-03, sets current-step: step-04 in state.yaml per this instruction, then the session is interrupted before step-04 (irreversible episodic deletion) actually runs. On resume, the workflow reads current-step: step-04 and jumps straight into deletion, bypassing the pre-deletion guardrail checkpoint entirely — the exact scenario the guardrail was added to prevent."
  },
  {
    "file": "workflows/system-eval/steps/step-03-grade.md",
    "line": 157,
    "summary": "Step instructs setting state.yaml current-step to step-04-score, but this step's own NEXT STEP link (and workflow.md's table) now route to step-03b-guardrail-checkpoint first.",
    "failure_scenario": "system-eval runs step-03, writes current-step: step-04-score to state.yaml, then the session ends. On resume, the workflow reads current-step: step-04-score and skips step-03b's adversarial review of the grades entirely, so composite scoring in step-04 proceeds on ungated grades."
  }
]
```

Both findings are the same class of bug, introduced consistently by this diff's guardrail-checkpoint insertion (verified against `daily-review` and `morning-briefing`, which don't track `current-step` in state.yaml and so aren't affected). I checked the actual `step-03b-guardrail-checkpoint.md` files for both workflows and confirmed neither sets `current-step` itself, so nothing downstream corrects the value written by step-03. No other correctness bugs survived verification in the reviewed diff — the token-usage/pricing plumbing (`token_usage.py`, `record-step.py`, the two hooks' vendored-yaml import and `extract_frontmatter_block` helper), `guardrail-checkpoint.py`, and `dream-cycle/orchestrate.py`'s new compression/guardrail logic all checked out against their call sites and assertion files. One cleanup item worth a follow-up (not included above per the 8-bug cap and lower severity): `systems/eval-harness/record-step.py` lines 89-90 compute `positional` via a list comprehension that's immediately discarded and recomputed by the loop right after — dead code that should be deleted.
